place.name: Gelderland
place.description: Gelderland ( GHEL-dər-lənd, Dutch: [ˈɣɛldərlɑnt] ), also known as Guelders ( GHEL-dərz) in English, is a province of the Netherlands, located in the centre-east of the country. With a total area of 5,136 km2 (1,983 sq mi) of which 176 km2 (68 sq mi) is water, it is the largest province of the Netherlands by land area, and second by total area.
